page.layout: One blank outer cover (parchment or vellum binding), with no printed text. Stains and a faint mark near the top centre. The library scale and label at the right edge belong to the digitiser and are not transcribed.
page.notes: Outer cover of the volume, seen from the front. No printed text. Faint stains and rubbing on the upper middle and lower middle of the cover. Four tie-holes or thong marks along the left edge. The printed title, if any, is on the title page inside the volume, not on this cover.
